clauses.feature_definition: Use all cells, with arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Use the magnitude of the stated velocity field as a nonnegative spatial weight.
clauses.property_measure: Measure width along the x axis as the weighted root-mean-square distance from its weighted center.
clauses.aggregation_or_representation: Multiply the stated spatial weight by cell volume and normalize by its sum.
